name: Select
description: Choose one option, or several, from a menu.

label.description: The field's name, drawn above it.

isLabelHidden.description: Hides the label from sight; it still names the field for a screen reader.

errorMessage.description: Set means invalid: the field shows this message under it.

name.description: Names the value inside a Form block.

variant.description: secondary is for a field on a grey surface.

fullWidth.description: false takes the natural field width token.

defaultSelectedKey.description: Starts at this value; the merchant changes it. For single.

selectedKey.description: Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree. For single.

defaultSelectedKeys.description: Starts at this value; the merchant changes it. For multiple.

selectedKeys.description: Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree. For multiple.

onSelectionChange.description: The selected id, or ids for multiple.
